briefs.rationale: Rewritten to cover the seven gained pages — harmonic Hardy classes with Fatou limits, Hörmander estimates and the Levi problem, analytic hypersurfaces and local parametrisation, hyperbolic uniformization, elliptic functions and complex tori, Nevanlinna’s second main theorem with defects, and logarithmic capacity with Riesz decomposition — inside the existing contour-to-dbar arc; 120 words, within the brief budget.

Rewritten to add Minkowski embedding, convex-body discriminant bounds and class-group finiteness, and the logarithmic unit lattice with rank, regulator and S-units, alongside the existing congruence, Dedekind, ramification, completion and Frobenius-decomposition material; 120 words.

Rewritten to add cyclotomic arithmetic — ring of integers Z[ζ_n], discriminant, ramification and Frobenius decomposition of rational primes, and reciprocity via Gauss sums — alongside the existing Legendre–Jacobi, square-sum, L-function and prime-number-theorem material; 116 words.
